name: Valle de Sedano (Spain)
description: Square white flag with three wavy stripes from the hoist, yellow above, blue in the middle and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Sedano (a bridge and a river on green with stars).
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Sedano; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valle de Sedano arms — bridge and river with stars
